description: Free. For "what games are on this weekend?" or "when do Arsenal play?". Lists the upcoming fixtures on tactica.'s current forecast list for the English Premier League (EPL), EFL Championship, EFL League 1 & EFL League 2: fixtureId, kick-off time (ISO 8601, and kickoffUk with the UK date, weekday and time), league, teams, earliest first; freeSample marks the Match of the Round, whose forecast is free. Use this when you only want to browse fixtures. For one match, use get_match_forecast, get_case_file or get_betting_picks instead, with the team names (match: "Forest v Chelsea"): no need to call this first. Filters: league, team, period, day, dateFrom/dateTo (UK). Free, no payment. Read-only.

dateFrom.description: Optional. First UK date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-28

dateTo.description: Optional. Last UK date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-29

day.description: Optional. One weekday in the window, UK time, e.g. saturday. Example: saturday

league.description: Optional. One league: EPL, Championship, League 1 or League 2. Example: Championship

period.description: Optional. today, tomorrow, weekend (Friday to Monday, UK: the current one from Friday, else the next), midweek (Tuesday to Thursday, UK) or next7days (default). Example: weekend

team.description: Optional. Part of a team name, home or away, e.g. Wrexham. Example: Wrexham

name: list_fixtures
title: List upcoming fixtures
